=== no token (expect 401) ===
HTTP 401
=== with valid user token (expect 200) ===
HTTP 401

observation.command: echo "=== no token (expect 401) ==="; curl -s --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:5000/api/Strasse?skip=0&take=1"; echo "=== with valid user token (expect 200) ==="; UTOK=$(cat /tmp/user-token.txt); curl -s --max-time 10 -H "Authorization: Bearer $UTOK" "http://localhost:5000/api/Strasse?skip=0&take=1" -o /tmp/strasse-resp.json -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"; head -c 300 /tmp/strasse-resp.json
